#{Decouple utility evaluation from accumulated penalties by estimating base edge costs through subtraction of existing penalties, computing utilities strictly on the unaugmented distances to prevent runaway penalty inflation on repeatedly selected edges.}

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    current_edge_lens = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    avg_augmented_len = np.mean(current_edge_lens)
    lambda_param = 0.3
    penalty_step = lambda_param * avg_augmented_len
    
    # Reconstruct the raw, unmodified base distance by subtracting prior accumulated penalties
    base_lengths = np.maximum(current_edge_lens - (tour_counts * penalty_step), 0.0)
    
    # Compute Guided Local Search edge utility using base cost to avoid runaway feedback
    utilities = base_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    
    max_utility = np.max(utilities)
    threshold = 0.99 * max_utility
    selected_mask = utilities >= threshold
    
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_mask]
    
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalty_step
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += penalty_step
    
    return updated_edge_distance
